description: Angular component for a toggle button widget in the Thingsboard UI, managing appearance, scaling, and interactions.

classes.name: WidgetButtonToggleComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for a toggle button with customizable appearance and auto-scaling features.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating appearance, border radius, or auto-scale as needed.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up auto-scaling after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observers and CSS styles.

methods.name: validateSize
methods.description: Validates and triggers resize if auto-scale is enabled.

methods.name: updateAppearance
methods.description: Updates visual styles and CSS classes based on appearance settings.

methods.name: updateBorderRadius
methods.description: Calculates and applies border radius styling.

methods.name: updateAutoScale
methods.description: Sets up or removes resize observer for auto-scaling.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts scale of button content based on container size.
